provenance.source_provider: www.binance.com public klines endpoint (column 5 quote asset volume)

pre_stated_hypothesis.name: Quote Volume Dry-Up Breakout Continuation
pre_stated_hypothesis.description: Causal rolling z-score of real quote_volume_usdt; liquidity DRY-UP (z < -1.0) combined with a vol-scaled short-term breakout (|ret6|/RV72 > 1.25) triggers CONTINUATION in the breakout direction (long if ret6>0, short if ret6<0). Exit on vol normalization (z > -0.2), max hold, or direction flip. Execution shifted t->t+1. Triggers on LOW volume regime (dry-up), opposite of C23/C40 which trigger on HIGH volume/climax; different mechanic and regime.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c23: C23 = momentum on HIGH vol surge (vol_z high) riding ret24 direction. C41 = continuation on LOW vol dry-up with vol-scaled breakout, different trigger regime and signal construction.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c40: C40 = mean reversion/FADE on HIGH vol climax (opposite of ret24). C41 = continuation on LOW vol dry-up (opposite trigger regime), not a fade.

config.benchmark: buy-and-hold per asset (gross, no recurring turnover) on union of OOS WF windows; strategy net of fee+slippage on turnover
config.pre_stated_oos_edge_proven_rule: oos_edge_proven=true IFF executed exposure>0 AND for ALL cost-grid slices OOS net sum > 0 AND OOS net sum > B&H OOS sum on same OOS windows. Else false (fail-closed).

honest_assessment: NO PROVEN NET-OF-COST OOS EDGE. oos_edge_proven=false for all tested assets under pre-stated fail-closed rule.
